insights.body: Some apps are not converting installs into subscribers at their usual rate: YCV New Subs +21.2% vs Install +4.2% (better than its installs); YCP New Subs -15.4% vs Install -7.9% (worse than its installs). Revenue follows about a week later, so these are the apps to watch next week.

insights.title: Which app — App Total New User -11.8% is mostly YMK — not every app.
insights.body: App Total New User moved -11.8% overall, but the apps are far apart (All App -11.8%, YMK -20.4%, YCP -10.1%, YCV +9.8%). YMK accounts for most of it, so look at what changed in that one app rather than something affecting all of them.

insights.title: Which country — JP is out of line with every other country on App Total Revenue (+154.2% vs +10.4%).
insights.body: For YMK, App Total Revenue in JP is +154.2% while all countries together are +10.4% — a gap of +143.7pp. JP is about 5% of revenue, so it is big enough to be worth a look.

insights.title: Best and worst markets — CA turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (23.7% vs 10.8% overall).
insights.body: In CA, 23.7% of installs turn into new subs, versus 10.8% across all markets and apps (+12.9pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. CA is about 2% of revenue. Its App Total New Subs is +37.2% this period.

insights.title: Market trend — YCP is gaining ground fast on turning installs into subs (+28.1%, now 9.8%).
insights.body: In YCP, 9.8% of installs now turn into new subs — +28.1% versus last period. It is about 36% of revenue (a big revenue market): more of the people downloading are subscribing, which should help revenue within a week or two.
